character.name: 虎豹轻骑 / Tiger Leopard light cavalry
character.desc: Mature moustached cavalryman, close iron helmet with short red crest, cropped red neck scarf, fitted black light lamellar armor and bronze fittings. Mounted on a swift dark charcoal horse with light red saddle cloth, exposed legs and head. Long slim steel-tipped lance. Aerodynamic and distinctly lighter than heavy cavalry.
character.special: fast pursuit gallop, lance extended low, scarf streaming and horse stretched

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
